sn7.6:1.2: Atha kho jaṭā-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn7.6:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3.
sn7.6:1.4: Ekam antaṃ nisinno jaṭā-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.6:6.1: Evaṃ vutte jaṭā-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.6:6.3: Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti || || 1. Sāvatthi Jetavane || || 2.
